snippet.title: Pixel Fish // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/2942730/Pixel_Fish/

An eater with action roguelite elements. Swim around a hostile sea while you avoid dangers and eat fish to gain experience and grow. Play as one of twelve unlockable characters, each with different traits. Earn evolution points to upgrade your stats, allowing you to eat ever-larger fish.

Developed by
Conifer Studios
